claims: The Artemis II mission will reach speeds of approximately 24,500 mph (39,430 km/h) for trans-lunar injection.
The Artemis II mission will re-enter Earth’s atmosphere at roughly 25,000 mph (40,000 km/h) to test the heat shield.
The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket lifts off with 8.8 million pounds of thrust.
The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket reaches speeds over 17,000 mph shortly after launch.
Artemis II mission's launch/injection speed is ~24,500 mph (about Mach 33) to escape Earth's gravity.
Artemis II mission's reentry speed is ~25,000 mph (40,233 km/h) upon returning from the Moon.
The Artemis II capsule will be slowed to roughly 17 mph for final splashdown in the Pacific.
The Artemis II mission travels over 1.4 million miles total.
The Artemis II mission takes the crew around the moon and back over a 10-day mission.
